summary: Round 1 had no findings. Since round 1 (a911e01..534f52f) the only non-doit changes are test-only: new e2e/hint-observed.spec.ts and a logging addition in e2e/support/records-harness.tsx; no src/ files changed (confirmed via git diff --stat). The spec's Worker.prototype.postMessage wrapper is a Playwright init script in the test page only, passes messages through unchanged, and only records `observed` (seat/hands/vpip/pfr counts, no hole cards). The harness log pushes per-decision observed snapshots to window.__records in the test bundle, not shipped code. No new dependencies, no network, no secrets, no randomness. Its assertions also confirm the user's seat never appears in the hint's observed snapshot, which supports the round-1 hidden-information analysis.
